children: RNS Number : 2984T  Golden Prospect Precious Metals Ltd  07 September 2026
Change of Service Provider and Registered Office

The board of directors of the Company (the "Board") announces that, with effect from 4 September 2026, the Company has appointed NSM Funds Limited of Les Echelons Court, Les Echelons, St Peter Port, Guernsey, GY1 1AR as its Administrator and Company Secretary.
The Board wishes to thank Apex Fund and Corporate Services (Guernsey) Limited, which previously fulfilled these functions.
The Board also announces that, with effect from 4 September 2026, the Company's registered office has changed to Les Echelons Court, Les Echelons, St Peter Port, Guernsey, GY1 1AR.
Jos Simson / Gareth Tredway / Eliza Logan

Golden Prospect Precious Metals Limited is a closed-ended investment company incorporated with limited liability in Guernsey on 16 October 2006. The Company's investment objective is to provide Shareholders with capital growth from a portfolio of smaller companies involved in the gold and precious metals mining sector.
